name: MagicSchool
tagline: AI platform for teachers, schools, and students
description: MagicSchool gives teachers 80+ AI tools for lesson planning, IEPs, rubrics, differentiated assignments, and parent communication. It also offers a moderated student experience (MagicStudent) with strict guardrails. Used by 5,000+ schools across the U.S. and beyond.
pricingDetails: Free for individual educators (limited tools). Plus: $99.96/year. Schools/Districts: custom per-seat.
